title: System Test Case Design from Requirements Specifications: Insights and Challenges of Using ChatGPT

live_model.evidence: "For generating test case designs, we used ChatGPT-4o Turbo model. We employed prompt-chaining, starting with an initial context-setting prompt, followed by prompts to generate test cases for each use case."
